In his farewell address, UN Secretary‑General António Guterres warned that AI could become a new weapon of war.

He urged nations to adopt common AI rules and to stop every armed conflict, putting peace first 🌍.

What steps can the global community take today to ensure AI serves humanity, not destruction?
